correctness.rationale: The family is precisely the binary masks with at most two positive runs, including empty word; run-boundary combinatorics gives |H_n|=Σ_{j=0}² C(n+1,2j), VCdim=min(n,4) by four-point realizability and the five-point alternating obstruction. A depth-d shattered online query tree exists if and only if some first coordinate i divides the present hypothesis set into two nonempty fibers both having depth-(d-1) shattered trees. The recursive predicate on finite hypothesis subsets is therefore an exact inductive characterization, with sound |S|<2^d pruning. Independently implemented bitmask recurrence exhaustively proved (Ldim n=1..14)=(1,2,3,4,4,5,5,6,6,7,7,8,8,9) with exact n14 |H|=1471 and 71028 reached memo states in the distinct run. n7 has 99 concepts and dimension five (strictly below log2-cardinality ceiling six); n14 dimension nine below ceiling ten. Source depth-5/depth-9 certificates were identified in the frozen Git tree; the independent complete recurrence verifies both lower and upper bounds without depending on their printed logs. No claim beyond n14 is made.
residual_risks: The independent exact solver implements the same mathematical splitting recurrence in a different bitmask traversal; a complete unrelated formal proof was not attempted.
The certificate JSON files were identified via blob hashes, but the independent check relied on exhaustive recurrence, not separate replay of their original encoded bytes.

originality.rationale: This is a finite-class enumeration in an established concept family; VC dimension four and the general root-splitting formula are standard. Alon–Beimel–Moran–Stemmer (2020) and Ghazi–Golowich–Kumar–Manurangsi (2020/21) analyze generic Boolean aggregation closure bounds and do not fix the exact finite two-interval Littlestone table or the first n7 counting shortfall. Chase–Freitag–Reyzin (2023) discuss a family of mutually disjoint intervals, not arbitrary unions of up to two intervals on a chain. An equivalent result under bounded-one-run/online segmentation terminology or a database table remains possible. Searches of published research records did not identify exact covering values.

value.rationale: Unions of two intervals are a canonical hypothesis family of VC dimension four, and online shattering depends on query adaptivity rather than static labeling. Finding the sharp first split between VC and Ldim at n6 and between Ldim and a mere cardinality ceiling at n7 identifies nontrivial finite structural barriers. The complete sequence through n14, independently finite-certified with precise constructive/obstruction recurrence, is a natural benchmark that a future learner-theory researcher could directly need. Its finite scope is explicit; no artificial claim of asymptotic classification is made.
